g.text: C23 Darwin targets: call leases, allocation origins and retirement
No SMP/multiple VMs; keep own hashes
OBJ/RTS direct; DYN GSTATE slot under recorded defaults
bare malloc/free provider not covered by GSTATE generation
ABI + family + images + optional FILE owner
reserve before malloc; record same operation
uncaptured pointer retains provider; no retry
closed ordinary gate still permits origin cleanup
physical free effect alone is not receipt
release FILE/code/state only after final dependency
cohorts, binding rows, writer and issuer contracts
compiled joins; loaded native gaps remain blocked
